summary: Quoin Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 424B5 base prospectus dated November 4, 2026, registering up to $150,000,000 in ordinary shares represented by ADSs, warrants, subscription rights, debt securities and units for offer from time to time. No specific offering, price per share, or terms were set; the filing is a routine shelf takedown vehicle. ADSs trade on Nasdaq under QNRX at $4.02 as of October 23, 2026, with public float of roughly $36.4 million, capping I.B.6 primary sales at one-third of float over 12 months. Watch for a future prospectus supplement pricing any actual offering.
